ROOT_CAUSE: v2.0.38 could force a second top-level Chrome window during otherwise healthy Monitor Only operation because the authorized launch path still supplied --new-window and could relaunch after a transient CDP endpoint miss even while the selected managed Chrome process remained alive.
DELIVERED_BEHAVIOR: Connect Profile and Refresh Chats remain passive and contain no Chrome process-launch authority.
Explicit Start Monitor remains the sole browser-launch authorization boundary.
Start Monitor first reuses the exact reachable selected managed CDP endpoint and performs zero Process.Start calls while that endpoint remains healthy.
A recently reachable selected endpoint is given a bounded 30-second reuse window before any launch decision, preventing transient CDP probe misses from opening another Chrome.

A GPTDeskTop-managed Chrome process that is still alive is never killed or relaunched merely because its CDP endpoint is temporarily unavailable; the pending message is preserved and the same session is retried.
The forced --new-window switch was removed from the single authorized Chrome launch boundary.
Fresh Chat creation remains a CDP target operation inside the already-connected selected browser and does not launch another browser process or window.
Recovery may relaunch only after explicit Start Monitor authorization and genuine loss of the selected managed browser session; unrelated personal Chrome remains outside the mutation boundary.
Exactly-once, uncertain-submit duplicate protection, JSON plan checkpoints, and rate-limit pacing were preserved unchanged.
